description: A distinguished English butler in his fifties, speaking French fluently with a light, refined British accent. Deep, warm baritone voice, calm and measured pace, impeccable diction, courteous and composed, with a hint of dry wit. Clean studio recording, close microphone, no background noise, no music.
texte: Bonsoir, monsieur. Votre thé est servi, les rideaux sont tirés, et j'ai pris la liberté de préparer vos dossiers pour demain matin.
